svg.title: A request and its possible outcomes
svg.desc: A Slack message reaches the clone, which judges it. While Require my approval is on, its reply and any work it would start wait on Home for your OK, and a declined one sends and starts nothing. The clone judges the message as a refused request, a question, your own change to a service, research or work. A refusal ends with what the person's side needs. A question ends with an answer, or goes to you when the asker may not ask for work. Your own change is made, and anyone else's changes nothing. Research ends with an answer or a blocked report, and a confirmed problem goes on as work. Work goes to a worker per independent part and ends with an open pull request, a merge where workers may merge, or a result in the thread, and it can wait on something missing, stop, be blocked by a sign-in or access, or ask you one short question. The numbered list under the diagram describes every path.
